Problems.title: Why Businesses Struggle to Scale Online
Problems.subtitle: Every brand hits the same wall — traffic plateaus, ads stop converting, and growth stalls. The issue isn't effort — it's structure.
Problems.helper: Tap any card to see how we approach it. Each problem has a clear, executable solution built into our workflow.

reach.title: Stagnant Reach
reach.problem: Outdated strategies fail to drive consistent traffic, and brand visibility slowly declines across every platform.
reach.solution: Data-driven growth strategies with continuous A/B testing, audience refinement, and platform-native distribution that keeps reach climbing.

engagement.title: Low Engagement
engagement.problem: Static posts and generic ads fail to capture attention in a feed that's already saturated with content.
engagement.solution: High-retention video ads and platform-specific creative built around hooks, pacing, and story — designed for the first three seconds.

branding.title: Weak Branding
branding.problem: Inconsistent visuals and scattered messaging make the business blend into the crowd — nothing feels ownable.
branding.solution: A unified brand system — logo, typography, palette, and messaging — applied consistently across every touchpoint.

funnels.title: Leaky Funnels
funnels.problem: Slow, unoptimized websites turn warm leads away before they ever reach checkout or contact.
funnels.solution: Fast, mobile-first pages with clear paths, sharp CTAs, and analytics wired in so every drop-off point is visible and fixable.

services.question: What services do you offer?
services.answer: We handle the full digital stack — Digital Marketing, Video Production, Branding & Design, and Web Development. Everything is delivered in-house by a single team, so your strategy, voice, and execution stay consistent across every channel.

global.question: Do you work with clients outside Bahrain?
global.answer: Yes. We're based in the Kingdom of Bahrain with a global client base. We deliver across regions and time zones without losing local nuance — whether your audience is regional or international.

bilingual.question: Do you deliver content in both Arabic and English?
bilingual.answer: Absolutely. Arabic and English are both handled natively by our team — no translation layer, no mixed messaging. Every asset is written, designed, and reviewed in the language it's meant for.

pricing.question: How does pricing and payment work?
pricing.answer: Custom projects (web, app, branding) require a 50% non-refundable advance deposit, with the remaining 50% due prior to final launch or code transfer. Monthly marketing and managed ad retainers are billed 100% upfront and due 5 days before the start of each cycle.

revisions.question: How many revisions are included?
revisions.answer: Custom development and graphic design projects include up to 3 standard revision rounds within the agreed initial scope. Any major structural changes or feature additions outside the original proposal are billed at standard hourly rates.

start.question: How do we get started on a project?
start.answer: It starts with a discovery call to understand your goals, audience, and timeline. From there, we send a tailored proposal with scope, deliverables, and timeline. Once approved and the deposit is settled, we kick off within the week.
